purpose: S0 short run of the role-policy harness, mode global (docs/stage1_role_policy_harness_plan_20261009.md, S0 and 3.3.1). Observes whether a real model uses the control-message convention (spawn markers, GLOBAL-POLICY broadcasts), rejection and correction, injection size and prompt-cache reporting. Not an effect comparison and not a score study. One Team run; no Single arm, optimizer, reviewer, evolution, resume or automatic rerun.
limitations: One hour instead of six. The saved P1 A/C, provider, resources and runtime switches carry over from the 2026-10-03 run; the code is not the same, since it adds the role-policy mechanism (injection, control messages, ledger, compat records). Short runs show convention use and failure modes, not task outcomes; the official evaluation still runs and its score is not comparable with six-hour runs. Missing usage and missing cache fields stay unknown; prices are not configured.
